3. H2: Who We Are

Our roots go back to 1966, when Robert and Diane Shupe started Service Blue, a blueprint business, in their family basement. Over six decades, it grew into Vision Graphics, a large-format and signage producer with a production facility in Salt Lake City.

We expanded across Utah and Nevada, then beyond. In 2024, Banner Capital Management became our growth partner, and Queen of Wraps and 1Source have since joined the Vision Graphics family.

We serve brands nationwide. For New York City clients, that history means the production depth to handle one sign or a multi-location program, with the same standards on every job.

Image AI Image: Photorealistic photograph, 3:2, of a modern large-format printer running in a bright production facility, with a glass display case at the edge of the frame holding rolled blueprint tubes, suggesting six decades of history, soft daylight, warm palette with one open accent, no people, no readable text, no logos.

4. H2: Where Your Signs Are Made

We make most signs at our Salt Lake City production facility and ship them to your project. Specialty items can come from other Vision Graphics locations or trusted partners.

Production You Can Ask About

Our team handles large-format printing, finishing, and fabrication, and can share equipment and material details for your sign. Ask our team about materials, equipment, and lead times.

Checked Before It Ships.

We check every piece against the drawing you approved. What leaves our facility matches what you signed off.

Packed and Shipped to Your Project

We pack signs for transit and ship them to your NYC address or installer. We plan transit time into your schedule, so installation dates line up with delivery.

Image AI Image: Photorealistic photograph, 3:2, of finished sign panels and letters wrapped in protective film and stacked on pallets beside a loading dock in a clean production facility, early morning light, a faceless worker silhouette with a pallet jack in the distance, warm neutral palette with one open accent, no readable text, no logos, no vehicles.

5. H2: How We Install in New York City

Licensed installation partners handle your New York City installation. The city requires a licensed sign hanger for most installs, and we manage the schedule from delivery to final mounting.

Licensed Partners

Installers with the right licenses for NYC. A licensed sign hanger installs your sign, and a licensed electrician makes the final connection on lit signs. We prepare the permit paperwork and coordinate the licensed filer.

Insurance

We can provide a certificate of insurance upon request. Buildings set their own coverage requirements, so our team confirms yours before work starts.

Building Access and After-Hours Work

We schedule installs around your building's rules. That includes evenings, weekends, and freight elevator windows, and we confirm any added labor charges in your quote.

See how we handle installation in New York City.

6. H2: Who You Work With

A Vision Graphics project lead is your single point of contact from the first photo to the final install.

Your lead keeps drawings, approvals, and schedule in one place, so you always know who to call.

Questions about site visits, meetings, references,s or building requirements go to our team, and they will answer them.

7. H2: Our Work

Projects shown here come from other Vision Graphics locations, and each is labeled with its city. Our work appears in stadiums, restaurants, retail spaces, and events across the country. See more on our projects page.

Where it fits

Independent Businesses

One sign or a full storefront refresh, started from a photo. We handle design, production, and installation coordination so you don't have to manage multiple vendors.

Office and Property Programs

Lobby, suite, and tenant signage kept consistent across a building or a portfolio. We plan landlord approvals and building access from the start.

Multi-Location Brands

Consistent brand programs with coordinated production and installation across sites. One set of drawings and finishes follows every location.

    9. H2: Common Questions

    Where are your signs made?

    We make most signs at our Salt Lake City production facility and ship them to your project. Specialty items can come from other Vision Graphics locations or trusted partners. Shipping time is built into your schedule. Ask our team about materials and lead times for your sign.

    Do you have an office in NYC?

    Our team serves New York City projects and arranges site visits and meetings around your address. Every project has a Vision Graphics project lead as your single point of contact. Contact our team with your address, and we will confirm how we handle your site.

    Who installs the signs?

    Licensed installation partners install your sign because New York City requires a licensed sign hanger for most installations. A licensed electrician makes the final connection on lit signs. We manage the schedule and building access, and we tell you who will be on site before installation day.

    Are you insured?

    Yes. We can provide a certificate of insurance upon request and send it before work begins. Buildings set their own coverage wording, so send us your requirements early, and our team will confirm what we can provide.

    Can you handle multi-location programs?

    Yes. As a sign company NYC property managers and multi-site brands can call on, we handle one address or many, with the same drawings, finishes, and schedule across every site. Tell us each address, and we confirm permits, production, and installation for each one.

    Can you provide references?

    Yes. We have happy clients who are glad to talk about their experience. Contact our team with your project type, and we will arrange a conversation.
